figures.caption: Figure 1: Orientation grounding extends localization grounding from predicting where a referred object is to estimating how it is oriented. ReferOri provides single-view and multi-view annotations with object boxes, 6D orientation, and axial symmetry labels, enabling OG-VLM to ground both object position and object-centric direction.

Figure 3: Overview of OG-VLM. Given multi-view frames, a single frame, or a 3D point cloud together with a text or box query, the VLM backbone generates structured grounding outputs with separate <bbox> and <ori> spans. Lightweight heads attached to the corresponding tokens provide localization, orientation, and symmetry supervision through geometry-aware losses.
